text:
Ainsley Patel: Sharing the company OKR draft + proposed launch-readiness checklist for Q2. Need alignment on scope and any hard blockers from eng/security/sales by EOD Friday.
Maria Chen: skimmed — curious about Dedicated capacity timing, we list 'Dedicated GA' as Q2 week 6 but infra said GPUs constrained that week. Can we move the cutoff or scope down the GA definition?
Samir Gupta: For the latency OKR, are we measuring p95 across hosted + dedicated or just hosted? That changes rollout plan.
Jordan Lee: Legal note: Private deployments require SOC2 evidence for the audit customers — we should add an explicit compliance gating criterion in the launch checklist.
Leo Morales: A couple of sales-led customer asks (enterprise embeddings SLA + bring-your-own-KMS) appear under "stretch." One named customer wants BYOK in Q2. We should decide if that gets escalated to committed OKR or kept as backlog.
Ainsley Patel: Good points. Proposal: 1) Move Dedicated GA to 'week 8' to avoid the current capacity crunch. 2) Measure latency p95 for hosted + dedicated combined (weighted by traffic). 3) Add "SOC2 evidence confirmed" as mandatory launch gate. 4) BYOK remains a committed engineering spike (OKR subtask) but target GA in Q3 unless sales funds an expedited effort. Thoughts?
Maria Chen: moving GA to week 8 works for me. If sales funds BYOK we should add a narrow acceptance criteria: BYOK must support AWS KMS only for Q2 to keep scope small.
Samir Gupta: agreed on combined p95; need to add canary traffic plan in rollout checklist — suggest `canary=5%` for 48h, fallback to v1 for errors. Also add `p95 <= target OR rollback`.
Jordan Lee: +1 on SOC2 gate. Add privacy review signoff too (data residency checks).
Emma Ortiz: high level — this OKR looks aligned with company priorities. My one ask: make sure we have a measurable revenue signal for the BYOK spike (customer commitment or PO) before we reclass it as committed.
Leo Morales: I'll coordinate with the named customer to get a letter of intent this week; if we get it, we can re-evaluate scope.
devops-bot: Deployment window note: Suggested maintenance slot for week 8 GA = Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC. Confirm with oncall.
Ainsley Patel: Updated doc: moved GA to week 8, added canary plan `5%/48h`, added SOC2 + privacy review as gates, BYOK stays spike with AWS-KMS limit unless LOI arrives. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you sign off or reply with blockers. I'll collate and publish final OKR on Monday if no outstanding objections.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
